title: VanillaPVP
description: A Vanilla PvP Pack That Has a No Fire Overlay Gets Rid Of Explosion Particles ADDS Fullbright & Makes Totem Pops Smaller!
body:
# WELCOME TO VANILLA PVP 
A Vanilla PvP Pack That Gets Rid Of Explosion Particles ADDS Fullbright Makes Totem Pops Smaller Gets Rid Of Smoke For Anchoring In Crystal PvP Overall A Better Pack Than The Minecraft Default Textures

## What This Adds
  This Texture Pack is a Vanilla Pack that makes totem pops smaller so if you get popped in a PvP battle or in your hardcore world its not taking up half this screen, gets rid of smoke
so if you are in a Crystal PvP fight you can actually see well, Adds Fullbright so if you are in a cave you don't need a ton of torches, COMPLETELY gets rid of fire from your screen (it doesn't fully get rid of fire it only makes it so that if you are in a fire its not covering your screen) and MORE!
## Features
Fullbright, No explosion Particles, No Smoke Particles, Smaller Totem Pops, Etc.
